title: The coordinator weighs making the owner's repos private, and brings one page question if it helps
why: Owner note on item 451 a (20:04 CST Nov 8): 'im open to making all repos private if that makes us happy'. Public repos expose page copies the export scan cannot judge (plain-word personal facts).
note: Filed by triage, Nov 8 20:04 CST. Not a ruling: the owner picked a (stay public). Weigh before asking: private repos pay Actions minutes after the free credit (macOS bills most), branch protection on a private repo needs a paid plan, and git history already pushed stays wherever it was cloned or forked. The coordinator brings the page question only if the gain is clear.
